summary: Tested forgot-password OTP reset flow end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed (known-email OTP, unknown-email null OTP, invalid OTP 400, valid OTP resets password + old password 401 + login with new works, OTP one-time-use, rate-limit 4th request 429). Frontend: full modal flow passed (open modal, auto-fill email from login form, auto-fill dev_otp, eye toggle, submit → success toast → modal closes → login form auto-filled → login → redirect to /home).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Forgot password?' trigger link with data-testid='forgot-password' was MISSING from the login form JSX. openForgot() handler, modal, state and all sub-elements existed but no element invoked openForgot. Nothing could open the modal. FIXED by adding a 'Забыли пароль?' button below data-testid='submit-auth' visible only in login mode.

action_items: Confirm the added 'Забыли пароль?' link styling/copy is acceptable (currently a small primary-colored link centered under the submit button, only shown in login mode).
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx was missing the trigger element for its own openForgot() handler — feature was 100% non-functional from UI until fixed by testing agent. Add a lint/UI smoke check for orphan handlers.

server.py forgot_password uses ISO-string comparison for created_at rate-limit ($gte with iso string); works only because ISO-8601 UTC strings sort lexicographically. Consider storing datetime objects for correctness/portability.
server.py is ~920 lines; consider splitting auth/reset flows into a dedicated router module.
test_credentials: Registered fresh users per run: reset_<ts>@lovreski.ru / password123 (then reset to newpass456/newpass789).
seed_data_creation: None beyond ephemeral test users created via /api/auth/register.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend forgot/reset endpoints fully verified. If retesting rate-limit, always use a fresh email since counts persist 15 minutes. The forgot-password link was added by the testing agent — if the main agent restyles it, keep data-testid='forgot-password' and ensure it only renders when mode==='login'.
